messages:
ana: quick follow-up from the postmortem  we still have recurring token churn failures during deploys. need owners + tight ETAs to avoid drift.
ben: i can own validation automation. plan: small e2e that rotates a key and asserts zero 401s across service restarts. CI job + nightly cron. ETA: 3 business days.
keerthi: i'll do audit enrichment  add `auth.rotation` breadcrumbs with `kid`, `actor`, `reason`, `service`. retention 90d searchable. will post mapping. ETA: 4 days.
oscar: ops will take deploy behavior + reload strategy. prefer hot-reload (SIGHUP) + phased rollout to avoid herd. i'll prototype a reload handler and update deploy-controller. ETA: 1 week.
sre-bot: created task TASK-12345: "postmortem-token-churn-remediations" (https://issues.redwood/TASK-12345)
nana: owners, please add a 1-line triage + blocker note to TASK-12345 by EOD. i'll consolidate and schedule a short sync if anything blocks.
ben: sample test i'll add: `./ci/rotate-and-check.sh --service checkout --duration 300`  will publish PR once local passes.
keerthi: i'll include a kibana saved view and a sample detection query for `auth.rotation` events.
oscar: will add a gradual rollout plan and a fallback (force-reload command) for emergency.
nana: proposed alert: `token_churn_401_rate > 0.25% over 10m` -> page oncall + attach TASK-12345. also a 7-day post-rollout digest to #incidents.
ben: ack  i'll wire the smoke tests to trigger the alert on failures.
keerthi: posting mapping to the task now.
nana: summary action items for tracking: ben: e2e rotation test + CI gate (ETA 3d) | keerthi: audit event + kibana view (ETA 4d) | oscar: reload handler + phased rollout + fallback command (ETA 1w) | ana: alerts + digest + coordination (ETA 2d). update TASK-12345 as you progress. :thumbsup:
oscar: noted, will ping when prototype branch is ready.
sre-bot: reminder set: status check in 5 days.
